card.name: Dose numbers and mg units
card.fires_on: The last digit of a dose number, the unit mg, a slash between two doses, or a percent sign right after a drug amount. It appears in dosing and strength statements for a named drug.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: The unit mg directly follows a dose number for a named drug.
modes.example: The recommended dosage for riluzole tablets is 50<< mg>> taken orally twice daily.

modes.label: Inside the number
modes.description: The final digit of a dose written as a multi-digit number.
modes.example: avir 10<<0>> mg once daily for 2 weeks

modes.label: Slash or percent
modes.description: A slash between two doses or a percent sign after a strength.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens (aging versus season words) show no clear link to doses, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the amount part of a drug dose, such as the number, mg, or percent.
